obraz: A root has lifted the paving stone and tipped it out of the path.
proc: Stone's weight gives way to the root's slow force
Weight gives way to force already there.

popis.happens: A root lifts a paving stone out of place.
popis.point: slow growth moves a heavy fixed thing

obraz: The tree that went into the ground as a stick now shades the bench.
proc: Planting long ago shows now as shade
Planting long ago shows now as unhurried result.

popis.happens: A stick grows into a tree that gives shade.
popis.point: something small grows large over years

obraz: The pear on the sill is still hard, and pressing it every day does not ripen it.
proc: Ripening at own pace, pressing cannot hurry it
Ripening at own pace, cannot be hurried.

popis.happens: The pear stays hard although it is pressed daily.
popis.point: checking does not speed up ripening

obraz: The bridge stands only because both banks carry it.
proc: What stands between two sides belongs to both
What stands between two sides belongs to both.

popis.happens: The bridge stands because two banks hold it.
popis.point: one thing depends on support from two sides

obraz: You sign your name under the complaint everyone else agreed with in the corridor.
proc: Takes a side openly, alone bears the cost
Openly taking a side others only whispered, at own risk.

popis.happens: You sign a complaint others only agreed with aloud.
popis.point: one person puts their name to it

obraz: You have typed the angry reply, and your thumb stops above the send button.
proc: Move stopped just before it is made
Move stopped just before it is made.

popis.happens: Your thumb stops before sending the angry reply.
popis.point: pausing just before an act of anger

obraz: The language practised a little each day comes out of your mouth on its own.
proc: Daily work long before ripens into result
Long earlier daily work ripens into unforced result.

popis.happens: The language comes out without effort.
popis.point: daily repetition makes a skill automatic

obraz: The recipe is followed from a card in handwriting that is not yours.
proc: A way handed down is carried on
Handed-down way carried on by another hand.

popis.happens: Someone cooks from a card another person wrote.
popis.point: using instructions handed on by someone else

obraz: Halfway through the washing-up the song comes on, and both of you start to sing.
proc: Shared joy in the middle of a chore
Shared lightness mid-task, not after finishing.

popis.happens: A song comes on and both start singing.
popis.point: a chore turns into shared pleasure

obraz: A green shoot has split the tarmac at the edge of the car park.
proc: Shoot splits tarmac: resistance gives way to force
Hard resistance gives way to pushing force.

popis.happens: A shoot splits the tarmac.
popis.point: a soft growing thing breaks hard ground

obraz: The cat hisses once, and your hand stops short of her kittens.
proc: Mother stands guard between hand and kittens
Mother stands guard between hand and kittens.

popis.happens: The cat hisses and your hand stops.
popis.point: a warning stops an approach

obraz: The tent pole bends double in the gust, and the tent is still there in the morning.
proc: Bends double under strain and does not break
Pole bends double under strain and does not break.

popis.happens: The pole bends in the wind and the tent survives.
popis.point: bending instead of breaking keeps it standing

obraz: The old house key still hangs on the ring, though the lock was changed.
proc: Old home's key still carried, choice to keep
Kept thing from former home, still carried on.

popis.happens: The key stays on the ring though it fits nothing.
popis.point: keeping a thing that no longer works

obraz: The rain keeps falling on the picnic, and the laughing under the one umbrella gets louder.
proc: Laughter grows together amid the spoiled picnic
Shared joy rises in the middle of the rain.

popis.happens: People laugh louder under one umbrella as rain continues.
popis.point: bad conditions bring people closer and merrier

obraz: The child ties the shoelace wrong, and the hand that could fix it stays in the pocket.
proc: Fragile beginning given room, not corrected by force
Care that gives room instead of fixing.

popis.happens: The adult does not fix the child's wrong knot.
popis.point: holding back help so someone learns

obraz: The red light holds you at the crossing while a lorry goes through.
proc: Stop at threshold protects from what rush missed
Stop just before the move protects from lorry.

popis.happens: The red light stops you while a lorry passes.
popis.point: a rule that holds you back protects you

obraz: The house is stripped to its beams for rebuilding, and the old beams carry the new roof.
proc: Old beams kept and chosen to carry the new
Choosing what old to carry into the new.

popis.happens: The old beams hold up a new roof.
popis.point: the old core carries what is rebuilt

obraz: The swallows build again under the same eave, on what is left of the old nest.
proc: Return to same place, building on what was left
Return to same place, building on what was left.

popis.happens: Swallows rebuild on the remains of their old nest.
popis.point: building again on what was left

obraz: One piece of the puzzle is still missing, and everyone at the table is pleased with it anyway.
proc: Shared pleasure without being finished
Shared pleasure without being finished.

popis.happens: People are pleased with a puzzle missing one piece.
popis.point: being content with something incomplete

obraz: The seedling moved to a bigger pot droops at first and then puts out a new leaf.
proc: Fragile life given room then grows
Fragile growth given more room, then grows.

popis.happens: The seedling droops, then grows a new leaf.
popis.point: a move sets back before it helps

obraz: Someone says aloud what the whole table was thinking, and the room breathes out.
proc: Spoken word at right moment changes the room
Spoken word at right moment changes the room.

popis.happens: Someone says the unspoken thing and the room relaxes.
popis.point: saying it aloud releases shared tension

obraz: The milk tooth is gone, the gap is tender, and the new tooth has not come through.
proc: Standing in the gap between two states
Standing tender between two states, old gone, new pending.

popis.happens: The old tooth is out and the new one has not come.
popis.point: the gap between losing and getting

obraz: You turn the map the other way up, and the road you could not find is where it always was.
proc: One turn and same map reads differently
One turn of view and same map reads differently.

popis.happens: You turn the map and find the road.
popis.point: changing the view reveals what was there

obraz: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the whole plan is gone with one announcement.
proc: Outside force breaks the whole plan at once
Outside announcement collapses the whole plan.

popis.happens: The flight is cancelled and the plan collapses.
popis.point: one outside event wipes out a plan

obraz: On the tandem the pedals fight until both riders find the same push, and then it flies.
proc: Two find common rhythm, then progress
Progress only when two riders share one rhythm.

popis.happens: The riders struggle, then pedal in time and go fast.
popis.point: matching rhythm turns struggle into speed

obraz: The advice you had heard many times makes sense the day you say it to someone else.
proc: Understands own lesson through another person
Understands oneself through speaking to another.

popis.happens: You understand old advice when you tell it to another.
popis.point: passing something on makes you understand it

obraz: The parcel has no sender's name, and you turn it over once more before opening it.
proc: Closed, contents exist but not yet known
Closed vessel, contents exist but not yet known.

popis.happens: You turn the unnamed parcel over before opening it.
popis.point: hesitating before something of unknown origin

obraz: The picture that was a vase is suddenly two faces, and it will not go back.
proc: Shift in seeing that cannot go back
Shift in seeing that cannot be undone.

popis.happens: A vase picture becomes two faces and stays so.
popis.point: a new way of seeing cannot be undone
popis.plausible: no - such pictures keep flipping back

obraz: Hail drums on the car roof, and when it stops every leaf in the garden is on the ground.
proc: Uninvited force, afterwards shows what is gone
Uninvited force from outside strips the garden.

popis.happens: Hail falls and knocks all the leaves down.
popis.point: a short violent event strips everything
popis.plausible: no - hail rarely strips every leaf

obraz: The dog stops pulling when the lead goes slack, and the two of you walk on at one pace.
proc: Neither forces, two walk at one pace
Two find one pace once neither pulls.

popis.happens: The dog stops pulling once the lead is slack.
popis.point: resistance ends when the pull ends

obraz: The radio has been on all day, and you hear it only when it says the name of your street.
proc: A heard word arrives and gains meaning
Heard word suddenly carries meaning.

popis.happens: You notice the radio only when it names your street.
popis.point: attention wakes when it concerns you

obraz: The film is still in the old camera, and no one remembers what was photographed.
proc: Images exist unseen, undeveloped, unknown
Pictures exist inside, undeveloped and unknown.

popis.happens: The film stays in the camera, its contents forgotten.
popis.point: something recorded but never looked at

obraz: Halfway through the tunnel the light ahead becomes larger than the light behind.
proc: Midpoint turn from dark toward light
Turning point where light ahead outweighs dark behind.

popis.happens: The light ahead grows larger than the light behind.
popis.point: passing the midpoint, the end gets nearer

obraz: The storm takes the trampoline over the fence and leaves the old shed standing.
proc: Storm shows what is gone and what held
Outside force breaks; afterwards shows what held.

popis.happens: The storm blows away the trampoline but not the shed.
popis.point: the light new thing goes, the old stays

obraz: Two saw the log together, and the blade runs only when neither of them pushes.
proc: Blade runs only when neither pushes
Works only when neither of two forces.

popis.happens: The saw cuts only when both pull and neither pushes.
popis.point: forcing it jams the shared work

obraz: The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
proc: A path made only by walking it
Path exists only because feet made it.

popis.happens: People wear a path nobody planned.
popis.point: real use makes the route, not plans

obraz: The oven door stays shut, because opening it now would let the cake fall.
proc: Kept closed while it completes inside
Kept closed while it completes itself inside.

popis.happens: The baker keeps the oven shut so the cake holds.
popis.point: looking too early would ruin it

obraz: The cursor blinks at the top of an empty page, and nothing has been typed.
proc: Empty page, nothing yet written
Open space where nothing has been written.

popis.happens: The cursor blinks on a page with nothing typed.
popis.point: a start that has not been made

obraz: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
proc: Scarcity shows the one thing truly needed
Scarcity forces out the one thing truly needed.

popis.happens: You send one message before the battery dies.
popis.point: scarcity forces choosing what matters

obraz: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
proc: Hears oneself mirrored in a friend
Sees own speech mirrored through a friend.

popis.happens: You hear a friend use your phrase.
popis.point: seeing yourself through someone else's copy

obraz: On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
proc: Easy rhythm of road no longer leads where meant
Easy rhythm of road carries past intended way.

popis.happens: You miss your turning on an easy road.
popis.point: ease makes you stop paying attention

obraz: The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
proc: Open enough to see, not letting all in
Open yet guarded, not letting everything in.

popis.happens: The door opens a little so you can see out.
popis.point: opening partly while staying protected

obraz: The form has a box with no label, and you leave it empty.
proc: Unnamed space left unwritten
Unlabelled space left unwritten.

popis.happens: You leave an unlabelled box empty.
popis.point: not answering what was not asked clearly

obraz: With one match left, you build the fire properly before you strike it.
proc: Constraint of one match forces what is needed
Constraint of one match dictates what matters.

popis.happens: You build the fire fully before striking the match.
popis.point: one chance, so prepare first

obraz: In the group photo you look first for your own face.
proc: Seeking oneself among the others
Looking for oneself among the others.

popis.happens: You look for your own face first.
popis.point: people check themselves before others

obraz: The first lengths in the pool are a fight; then the arms find their own count.
proc: Rhythm found only by keeping moving
Rhythm found only by keeping moving.

popis.happens: The swimmer struggles, then swims in rhythm.
popis.point: effort settles into rhythm after a hard start

obraz: The lifeguard's whistle turns the swimmers back before they reach the current.
proc: Watcher stands between swimmers and the danger
Watcher keeps swimmers from the threat.

popis.happens: The whistle turns swimmers back from the current.
popis.point: a warning stops people before danger

obraz: The signpost at the crossroads has lost its boards; only the post is left.
proc: Sign without any marking, direction unwritten
Sign carries no marking; direction unwritten.

popis.happens: The signpost has lost its direction boards.
popis.point: a guide that no longer gives direction

obraz: The water is off, and you notice every time your hand goes to the tap.
proc: Lack makes the need felt each time
Lack makes the need visible each time.

popis.happens: Your hand keeps reaching for a tap with no water.
popis.point: absence shows how often you relied on it

obraz: Someone imitates the way you walk, and the whole room knows who it is.
proc: Self shown back through another, recognised by all
Oneself shown back through another person, recognised by all.

popis.happens: Someone copies your walk and everyone recognises you.
popis.point: others know you by a habit

obraz: The phone torch finds the keys under the car seat, and everything else that fell there.
proc: Small light reveals what lay there all along
Small light reveals more than was sought.

popis.happens: The torch shows the keys and other lost things.
popis.point: searching for one thing uncovers more

obraz: The bird drops low and drags a wing, and the fox follows her away from the nest.
proc: Puts herself between threat and nest
Bird puts herself between threat and nest.

popis.happens: The bird fakes an injury and leads the fox away.
popis.point: pretending weakness to draw danger off

obraz: The rain barrel fills to the brim and runs over into the bed where the potatoes grow.
proc: Surplus passes on and feeds growth
Surplus passes on and feeds growth elsewhere.

popis.happens: The barrel overflows onto the potato bed.
popis.point: what is over-full spills on to feed others

obraz: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
proc: Moving water stopped and held as it is
Flowing water stopped and held in place.

popis.happens: The waterfall has frozen solid.
popis.point: moving water stopped by cold

obraz: Your foot finds the brake before you have seen why.
proc: Sensed and acted on before it can be explained
Body senses danger before it can be explained.

popis.happens: Your foot brakes before you see the reason.
popis.point: the body reacts before the mind knows

obraz: You change the dead bulb in the hallway and see how long the walls have needed paint.
proc: Light shows what was long there, cannot be unseen
Small light reveals what was there all along.

popis.happens: You change the bulb and see the shabby walls.
popis.point: fixing one thing shows other neglect

obraz: The fog burns off by noon, and the whole valley you were walking through is suddenly there.
proc: Sun clears fog, you see where you stand
Sun clears fog; one sees where one stands.

popis.happens: The fog clears and the valley becomes visible.
popis.point: what was around you suddenly shows

obraz: The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
proc: Left unused, it lost its strength
What stood unused lost its strength.

popis.happens: The unused battery is flat when needed.
popis.point: what is never used fails when needed

obraz: A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
proc: Rising movement stopped and held under ice
Rising movement halted and held under ice, visible.

popis.happens: Bubbles rise and stop under the ice.
popis.point: something rising is stopped by a lid

obraz: The float lies still on the water, then dips once before anything is seen.
proc: Movement under surface sensed before seen
Movement under surface sensed before seen.

popis.happens: The float dips once before anything shows.
popis.point: a first small sign of something unseen

obraz: The idea comes in the shower, and by the time you find a pen half of it is gone.
proc: A spark that fades unless fed at once
Small insight appears and fades when not fed.

popis.happens: An idea comes and half is lost before writing.
popis.point: a thought fades unless caught quickly

obraz: The sun comes round the house, and the frost on that side of the path is gone.
proc: Sun simply shines and its strength melts frost
Sun simply shines and its strength melts frost.

popis.happens: The sun reaches the path and melts the frost.
popis.point: warmth arrives and the frost goes

obraz: The bicycle ridden every day runs smoothly; the one kept in the shed has seized.
proc: Used stays alive, left standing seizes
Used thing thrives; unused one loses its strength.

popis.happens: The used bicycle runs; the stored one has seized.
popis.point: use keeps things working, storage stiffens them

obraz: A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
proc: Motion halted mid-fall, one drop held in view
Moving drop stopped and held as it is.

popis.happens: A drop freezes on the icicle before falling.
popis.point: something caught at the last moment

obraz: The damp patch on the ceiling shows where the water has been travelling inside the wall.
proc: Hidden current finding its own way inside
Hidden current finding its own way inside wall.

popis.happens: A damp patch shows where hidden water ran.
popis.point: a visible mark reveals a hidden process

obraz: The borrowed dish comes back with something baked in it.
proc: Something passes between two hands and returns enriched
Something passes back between two hands, uncounted.

popis.happens: The dish is returned with baking in it.
popis.point: a loan is returned with a gift

obraz: You come out of the cinema into full daylight and stand still until you can see.
proc: Light too bright dazzles until eyes adjust
Full sunlight dazzles until one can see.

popis.happens: You stand still until your eyes adjust to daylight.
popis.point: needing time to adjust after a change

obraz: The car sits fast in the snow until you put your shoulder to it, and it rolls.
proc: Bodily force appears when needed, weight yields
Stuck weight yields to applied bodily force.

popis.happens: The stuck car rolls when you push it.
popis.point: it moves only with your own effort

obraz: The traffic has stopped on the mountain road, and people get out and look at the view.
proc: Movement stopped, in stillness one thing in view
Movement stopped; in stillness one thing in view.

popis.happens: People leave their cars and look at the view.
popis.point: a forced stop lets people notice surroundings

obraz: The chrysalis hangs on the fence and does not move, and inside nothing is left of the caterpillar.
proc: Outwardly still, transformation completing inside
Outwardly still while transformation completes inside.

popis.happens: The chrysalis hangs still while the caterpillar dissolves inside.
popis.point: total change hidden behind outward stillness

obraz: At the table one pours the coffee and the other cuts the cake, and no one keeps count.
proc: Giving both ways, nothing counted
Exchange between two, explicitly not counted.

popis.happens: One pours coffee, the other cuts cake, uncounted.
popis.point: giving to each other without keeping score

obraz: You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
proc: Keeps to truth and knowingly pays for it
Keeps honesty and knowingly pays the price.

popis.happens: You report the ball out and your team loses the point.
popis.point: honesty that costs your own side

obraz: The jammed window gives all at once when you put your whole weight behind it.
proc: Resistance yields to whole-body force
Resistance gives way to whole bodily weight.

popis.happens: The window opens suddenly under your full weight.
popis.point: full force frees what was stuck

obraz: You dig up the seed to see if it is growing, and now it is not.
proc: Opening what ripens inside before ready ruins it
Fragile beginning forced instead of given room.

popis.happens: You dig up the seed and stop its growth.
popis.point: checking on growth destroys it

obraz: The suitcase stands packed by the door, and there is nothing more to put in.
proc: Complete within, closed and ready, nothing visible happening
Closed and complete within, ready, nothing outwardly happening.

popis.happens: The suitcase is packed and ready by the door.
popis.point: preparation is finished, only leaving remains

obraz: You hold out a hand to help someone up, and their grip steadies you too.
proc: Help given returns; what arises belongs to both
Help given returns; steadiness belongs to both.

popis.happens: You help someone up and their grip steadies you.
popis.point: helping another supports the helper too

obraz: The two invitations are for the same evening, and you answer one of them.
proc: Choosing one side and forgoing the other
Choosing one side, knowingly giving up the other.

popis.happens: You accept one of two invitations for one evening.
popis.point: choosing one means giving up the other
